I am Christopher Landgraf, pro se intervenor. I am identified as Party Number 113 in

SOAH Order #31. At the beginning of the hearing today (6/10/2026), it is my

understanding that Judge Brite confirmed/stated that the direct testimony uploaded to

Egnyte (and assuming Kiteworks) should be the direct testimony originally uploaded

prior to the deadline for direct testimony. I have therefore uploaded my ‘original’ direct

testimony (in its entirety, with embedded Exhibits A-I) from PUC Interchange Item

Number 3977 as ‘Christopher Landgraf – Ex G’ to both Egnyte and Kiteworks which

should replace ‘Christopher Landgraf – Exhibit G’ in both systems. I have not uploaded

Exhibits G through I embedded in my original direct testimony as separate attachments

in both systems and am okay with them being excluded from the record. Additionally, I

have updated/uploaded my exhibit list below to reflect that Exhibit G is now my original
